data.description:
## Bug Report

**Priority**: 4 (backlog)
**Zero Inference Rule**: Directly observed in diff for PR #337 by FP-recovery opus review.

## Observed behavior
tests/integration/run-integration-tests.sh adds 'test-ref-library.sh' to _INTEGRATION_TEST_FILES twice: once via the literal filename and once via the glob 'test-ref-*.sh' which also matches it. The test runs twice on every integration run, inflating PASS/FAIL counts in the summary.

## Expected behavior
Each test file runs exactly once.

## Reproduction
The loop at line 16: for _f in "$SCRIPT_DIR"/test-ref-library.sh "$SCRIPT_DIR"/test-ref-*.sh; do echo $_f; done
prints the path twice.

## Fix
Drop the literal filename 'test-ref-library.sh' and keep only the glob 'test-ref-*.sh', or deduplicate the array before iteration.
data.title: run-integration-tests.sh: test-ref-library.sh counted twice via glob overlap
